_meta.notes: The same vessel as inner-belt, after the space-weather record stops arriving. The wire is identical and the link then drops. The dose rate, the shielding meter, every star and every CME slot are HELD and dated; what goes is the craft's POSITION in the environment, because it has moved since: the belt rings unlight, the 'you are here' dot is withheld, and the verdict pill drops to unknown rather than keeping a reassurance nobody can vouch for. Before this the whole board came off the screen and left one sentence.

_scene.caption: The same vessel after the link drops: dose, shielding and CMEs held and dated, the belt position and the verdict withheld
